A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the analytic model is not able to describe the mesomechanic effect of the ondulated plain-weave fabric.
the mesomechanic deformation of a single fabric reinforced layer is a function of the amplitude and the period of the ondulated layer.

the mesomechanic effect of ondulation is not negligible in fabric reinforced composite single layers and can be observed in FE-analyses as well as in an analytic model, but that the effect is much smaller in FE-analysese due to the elastic parts.

the FE-analysed mesomechanic strain is linearly correlated to the geometric parameters amplitude and length of the ondu- lation.
